items.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: Local Zone in Bogotá, 30-minute Lambda timeout, and more (November 24, 2026)

sentences.en: AWS Weekly Roundup: Local Zone in Bogotá, 30-minute Lambda timeout, and more (November 24, 2026).
sentences.zh: AWS 周报：波哥大 Local Zone、30 分钟 Lambda 超时等（2026 年 11 月 24 日）。

sentences.en: Some limits shape architecture more than any feature does.
sentences.zh: 有些限制对建筑的塑造作用超过任何特征。

sentences.en: AWS Lambda launched in 2014 with a 60-second timeout, moved to 5 minutes in 2015 and to 15 minutes in 2018, and then stayed there for eight years.
sentences.zh: AWS Lambda 于 2014 年推出时，超时时间为 60 秒，2015 年延长至 5 分钟，2018 年延长至 15 分钟，此后八年一直保持不变。

sentences.en: Last week the limit doubled, and in the same week Lambda learned to run on GPUs and gave platform teams their own runtimes.
sentences.zh: 上周，该限制翻了一番，在同一周，Lambda学会了在GPU上运行，并为平台团队提供了自己的运行时。

sentences.en: That is a lot of Lambda for one week.
sentences.zh: 一周内使用这么多Lambda函数。

sentences.en: Two other threads ran through the week.
sentences.zh: 本周还有另外两条主线。

sentences.en: A new AWS Local Zone in Bogotá brought AWS infrastructure closer to users in Colombia.
sentences.zh: 位于波哥大的新 AWS Local Zone 让 AWS 基础设施更贴近哥伦比亚的用户。

sentences.en: And AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) , Amazon Cognito , and Amazon CloudFront each shipped a piece of identity for agents: who an agent is when it shows up at your door, and how little it should be allowed to do.
sentences.zh: 此外，AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS)、Amazon Cognito和Amazon CloudFront都为代理提供了身份信息：当代理出现在您家门口时，它是什么身份，以及它应该被允许做什么。

sentences.en: Now, let’s get into this week’s AWS news… Headlines AWS Local Zone in Bogotá, Colombia – AWS opened a new Local Zone in Bogotá, so you can now run applications that need single-digit millisecond latency closer to users in Colombia.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来看看本周的AWS新闻……头条新闻：哥伦比亚波哥大的AWS Local Zone – AWS在波哥大开设了一个新的Local Zone，因此您现在可以在离哥伦比亚用户更近的地方运行需要个位数毫秒级延迟的应用程序。

sentences.en: AWS Local Zones place compute, storage, and networking near large metropolitan areas with the same APIs and tools as a Region, for workloads like real-time gaming, live streaming, and financial transactions.
sentences.zh: AWS Local Zones 将计算、存储和联网部署在靠近大都市的区域，并使用与区域相同的 API 和工具，适用于实时游戏、直播和金融交易等工作负载。

sentences.en: The Bogotá Local Zone supports Amazon EC2 C7i, M7i, and R7i instances, Amazon EBS gp3, gp2, and io1 volumes with local snapshots, Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access, Amazon ECS , Amazon EKS , AWS Direct Connect , and Application Load Balancer.
sentences.zh: 波哥大 Local Zone 支持 Amazon EC2 C7i、M7i 和 R7i 实例、具有本地快照的 Amazon EBS gp3、gp2 和 io1 卷、Amazon S3 单区域 - 不频繁访问、Amazon ECS、Amazon EKS、AWS Direct Connect 和 Application Load Balancer。

sentences.en: To start, enable us-east-1-bog-1a in AWS Global View.
sentences.zh: 首先，在 AWS 全局视图中启用 us-east-1-bog-1a。

items.title: Is “sort by impact” just vibes?

sentences.en: Is “sort by impact” just vibes?.
sentences.zh: “按影响排序”只是感觉吗？

sentences.en: “Give me the top five, sorted by impact.” People ask AI agents for this all the time, whether it’s a backlog or a pile of growth ideas.
sentences.zh: “按影响程度排序，给我前五名。” 人们经常向 AI 代理提出这样的要求，无论是待办事项还是大量增长创意。

sentences.en: Yet “impact” is one of the vaguest words in the language.
sentences.zh: 然而，“影响”是语言中最模糊的词汇之一。

sentences.en: It could mean how many users benefit, how much money comes in or how much you get for the effort.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着有多少用户受益、有多少收入或您因所付出的努力而获得多少回报。

sentences.en: Hardly anyone says which, so we suspected the order agents come back with is just vibes.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有人说出具体原因，所以我们怀疑订货代理商给出的理由只是感觉。

sentences.en: It looks plausible, but there’s nothing behind it.
sentences.zh: 这看起来有道理，但背后并没有什么东西。

sentences.en: We were wrong, though not in a reassuring way.
sentences.zh: 我们错了，但并不是以一种令人安心的方式。

sentences.en: Across 1,500 runs with four models, agents ranked the same list in nearly the same order every time, and different models largely agreed with each other.
sentences.zh: 在 1500 次运行中，使用四种模型，代理每次都以几乎相同的顺序对同一列表进行排名，并且不同模型的结果大体上一致。

sentences.en: Our prompt never said what impact meant, so the agents picked a definition themselves, and which one depended on the subject: users reached for a developer-tool backlog, revenue for an online shop and severity for security work.
sentences.zh: 我们的提示语从未说明“影响”的含义，因此客服代表自行选择了定义，而选择哪种定义取决于主题：用户选择了开发人员工具的待办事项，收入选择了网店，严重程度选择了安全工作。

sentences.en: When every item came with a dollar figure, “impact” meant the biggest dollar figure, every time.
sentences.zh: 当每项都附有美元金额时，“影响”每次都意味着最大的美元金额。

sentences.en: Three kinds of vibes When you ask an agent to sort a list by impact, the order you get back can be vibes in three ways, and each one needs to be fixed in a different way.
sentences.zh: 三种类型的偏差当你要求客服代表按影响程度对列表进行排序时，你得到的排序结果可能存在三种类型的偏差，每种偏差都需要以不同的方式进行纠正。

sentences.en: Kind of vibes What you’d see What fixes it Noise Ask again and you get a different order Ask several times, or don’t trust the ranking Artifact The order copies something irrelevant, like the order of your list Shuffle the list before you ask Hidden default The same order every time, based on a definition of impact the agent picked Tell the agent what impact means Eight items, ranked over and over If we let the agent come up with its own ideas, we’d be testing two things at once: which ideas it picks and how it ranks them.

items.title: Gaza issues meningitis epidemic alert after steep rise in cases

sentences.zh: 加沙在病例急剧增加后发布脑膜炎疫情警报。

sentences.en: Health ministry records 272 new infections in October, more than eight times the normal monthly rate Gaza’s health ministry has issued an epidemic alert after a sharp rise in meningitis infections, with more than 270 new cases reported in October.
sentences.zh: 卫生部记录了10月份新增272例感染病例，是正常月感染率的八倍多。加沙卫生部在脑膜炎感染病例急剧增加后发布了流行病警报，10月份报告的新增病例超过270例。

sentences.en: Dr Nidal Ghoneim, a senior official at the ministry, said the spread of the disease posed a threat to the lives of hundreds of thousands of people, including children.
sentences.zh: 该部高级官员Nidal Ghoneim博士表示，这种疾病的传播对包括儿童在内的数十万人的生命构成威胁。

items.title: The Nvidia case is just the latest episode of Trump disregarding intelligence

sentences.en: The Nvidia case is just the latest episode of Trump disregarding intelligence.
sentences.zh: Nvidia 一案只是特朗普无视情报的最新一幕。

sentences.en: Trump’s reaction to sensitive information that contradicts his worldview mirrors his conduct towards war with Iran Donald Trump’s unwillingness to heed warnings of suspected Chinese penetration of the tech giant Nvidia follows a pattern of the US president ignoring sensitive intelligence that contradicts his world view.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对与他的世界观相悖的敏感信息的反应，反映了他对与伊朗开战的态度。特朗普不愿听取有关中国涉嫌渗透科技巨头英伟达的警告，这与美国总统无视与他的世界观相悖的敏感情报的模式如出一辙。

sentences.en: Trump disregarded repeated information that the company’s co-founder, Jensen Huang, was having an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy that threatened to undermine Washington’s geo-strategically vital goal of pipping China for global supremacy in the artificial intelligence race.
sentences.zh: 特朗普无视反复传出的消息，即该公司的联合创始人黄仁勋与一名据称是中国间谍的女子有婚外情，这可能危及华盛顿在人工智能竞赛中超越中国、争夺全球霸主地位这一具有重要地缘战略意义的目标。

items.title: Leftwing coalition leader calls for rental revolution as Spain heads for snap election

sentences.en: Leftwing coalition leader calls for rental revolution as Spain heads for snap election.
sentences.zh: 随着西班牙即将举行提前选举，左翼联盟领导人呼吁进行租房革命。

sentences.en: Exclusive: Ada Colau hopes public anger over housing will transfer into support for her Broad Front coalition in Sunday’s vote The leader of Spain’s leftwing Broad Front coalition has called for a drastic rethink of the country’s entire housing rental system, and described the eviction of an 87-year-old woman – the spark for nationwide protests that in turn triggered Sunday’s snap general election – as “the last straw” for desperate tenants.
sentences.zh: 独家报道：阿达·科劳希望公众对住房问题的愤怒能在周日的投票中转化为对她领导的广泛阵线联盟的支持。西班牙左翼广泛阵线联盟的领导人呼吁对该国的整个住房租赁体系进行彻底的重新思考，并表示将一名87岁的老妇人驱逐出家门是“压垮绝望租户的最后一根稻草”，这一事件引发了全国范围的抗议活动，进而促成了周日的提前大选。

sentences.en: “We’re not interested in small changes,” Ada Colau, the former Barcelona mayor, told the Guardian in an interview.
sentences.zh: “我们对小小的改变不感兴趣。”巴塞罗那前市长阿达·科劳（Ada Colau）在接受《卫报》采访时表示。

sentences.en: “We want to reform the entire rental sector.” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: “我们希望改革整个租赁行业。”继续阅读……

items.title: Five women killed every hour by partners or family members

sentences.en: Five women killed every hour by partners or family members.
sentences.zh: 每小时有五名女性被伴侣或家人杀害。

sentences.en: Some 47,000 women and girls were killed by intimate partners or family members in 2025 – five every hour – according to new UN figures published on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 根据周二发布的联合国最新数据显示，2023年约有4.7万名妇女和女童被亲密伴侣或家庭成员杀害，相当于每小时有5人遇害。

items.title: Colombia: Guterres urges renewed commitment to landmark peace deal

sentences.en: Colombia: Guterres urges renewed commitment to landmark peace deal.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚：古特雷斯敦促各方重申对具有里程碑意义的和平协议的承诺。

sentences.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has commended Colombia for progress achieved in the decade since a landmark accord known as the Final Peace Agreement ended more than 50 years of insurgency but stressed the need to fully implement its provisions.
sentences.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯赞扬了哥伦比亚在签署一项名为《最终和平协定》的里程碑式协定以终结长达50余年的叛乱之后的十年里所取得的进展，但强调需要全面落实该协定的各项条款。

items.title: DR Congo: Concern for trapped Ebola workers as violence against women and girls deepens

sentences.en: DR Congo: Concern for trapped Ebola workers as violence against women and girls deepens.
sentences.zh: 刚果民主共和国：随着针对妇女和女童的暴力行为加剧，人们对受困埃博拉医护人员的关切日益加深。

sentences.en: Staff from the World Health Organization (WHO) and Ebola responders remain trapped in a hospital in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), as heavy fighting continues in the vicinity, the UN agency said in an update on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国机构周二在最新消息中表示，由于刚果民主共和国（刚果（金））伊图里省附近持续发生激烈战斗，世界卫生组织（世卫组织）的工作人员和埃博拉疫情防控人员仍被困在该省的一家医院内。

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Can conflict resolution keep pace as AI and drones reshape war?

sentences.en: Security Council LIVE: Can conflict resolution keep pace as AI and drones reshape war?.
sentences.zh: 安全理事会直播：随着人工智能和无人机重塑战争，冲突解决能否跟上步伐？

sentences.en: When the UN was founded in 1945, computers, the internet and satellites were the stuff of science fiction.
sentences.zh: 联合国成立于1945年，当时计算机、互联网和卫星还只是科幻小说中的事物。

sentences.en: Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is already assisting in targeting, drones are reshaping warfare and disinformation is spreading in unprecedented ways, fuelling record levels of conflict.
sentences.zh: 如今，人工智能（AI）已经在协助瞄准目标，无人机正在重塑战争的面貌，虚假信息正以史无前例的方式传播，助长了冲突达到创纪录的水平。

sentences.en: The Security Council on Tuesday is weighing these changes, with UN chief António Guterres telling ambassadors, “killer robots must have no place in our future.”
sentences.zh: 安全理事会周二正在权衡这些变化，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（António Guterres）对各国大使表示：“杀手机器人绝不能出现在我们的未来。”

items.title: ‘Far too much failure’: UN deputy chief’s final call to end violence against women

sentences.en: ‘Far too much failure’: UN deputy chief’s final call to end violence against women.
sentences.zh: “失败太多”：联合国副秘书长最后呼吁杜绝暴力侵害妇女行为。

sentences.en: UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed warned on Tuesday that another woman or girl would be killed by a partner or family member before she finished speaking, as she called for justice for survivors and consequences for perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 联合国副秘书长阿米娜·穆罕默德周二警告称，在她发言结束前，又有一名女性或女孩将被伴侣或家庭成员杀害，她呼吁为幸存者伸张正义，并对施暴者予以惩罚。

items.title: Decades of gains against AIDS could unravel as HIV funding dries up

sentences.en: Decades of progress against AIDS, one of the greatest public health achievements in history, could go into reverse as international HIV funding is cut and campaigns against human rights and gender equality gain ground, the UN agency devoted to ending the pandemic warned Tuesday in a new report.
sentences.zh: 联合国致力于终结艾滋病大流行的机构周二在一份新报告中警告称，随着国际艾滋病防治资金的削减以及反人权和性别平等的运动的抬头，数十年来在防治艾滋病方面取得的进展——历史上最伟大的公共卫生成就之一——可能会出现逆转。

items.title: Kubernetes v1.38 Sneak Peek

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.38 Sneak Peek.
As we get closer to the release date for Kubernetes v1.38, the project develops and matures, features may be deprecated, removed, or replaced with better ones for the project's overall health.

This blog post outlines some of the planned changes for the Kubernetes v1.38 release that the release team feels you should be aware of for the continued maintenance of your Kubernetes environment and keeping up to date with the latest changes.
The information listed below is based on the current status of the v1.38 release and may change before the actual release date.

Deprecations and removals for Kubernetes v1.38 kubectl: WebSocket opt-out environment variables removed kubectl has used WebSockets instead of SPDY by default for kubectl exec , attach and cp since v1.30, and for kubectl port-forward since v1.31.
The KUBECTL_REMOTE_COMMAND_WEBSOCKETS and KUBECTL_PORT_FORWARD_WEBSOCKETS environment variables let you turn that behavior off.
These variables are going to be removed in v1.38.
kubectl will then always try WebSockets first and fall back to SPDY when it needs to (the same as the current default behavior).
If your scripts or CI environments set either of these environment variables, you can remove them since they will no longer have any effect.
To learn more, refer to KEP-4006: Transition from SPDY to WebSockets .

kubectl: name dropped from kuberc credential plugin allowlist entries The kuberc file keeps kubectl user preferences separate from cluster credentials in the kubeconfig, including an allowlist of the credential plugins kubectl is allowed to run.
In the beta kubectl.config.k8s.io/v1beta1 API, an allowlist entry can use name as an alias for command .
